title: Characters, Themes and Key Events
summary: كل شخصيات The Lost World (نسخة الوزارة، 10 فصول) بصفاتها والدليل عليها، الأفكار الكبيرة، جدول الأحداث بالفصول، وأسئلة بالإجابات.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: This lesson studies the **characters**, the **themes** (big ideas) and the **key events** of *The Lost World* (the Ministry reader, 10 chapters). For each character you will learn two or three **traits** (qualities) and the **evidence** from the story that proves them.

blocks.text: في الدرس ده هنعرف **كل شخصية مهمة** في الرواية: صفاتها إيه، وإيه **الدليل** من القصة على كل صفة، وفي أنهي **فصل (Chapter)**. وبعدين هنشرح **الأفكار الكبيرة (themes)** اللي الكاتب عايز يقولها، وجدول بأهم الأحداث، وفي الآخر أكتر من 20 سؤال بإجاباتهم.
ليه الدليل مهم؟ لأن أسئلة الرواية في الكتاب بتيجي بشكل **JRE**: لازم تقول رأيك، وتشرح، و**تجيب دليل من القصة**. مينفعش تقول «Challenger is proud» وخلاص، لازم تقول **إمتى** ظهر ده.
يعني إيه trait و evidence؟

text: A **trait** is a quality of a person, such as *brave*, *proud* or *loyal*. **Evidence** is what the character says or does in the story that shows this trait.

blocks.text: **trait** = صفة في الشخصية (شجاع، مغرور، مخلص…). **evidence** = حاجة الشخصية **عملتها أو قالتها** في القصة وبتثبت الصفة دي. القاعدة: **صفة + دليل = إجابة كاملة**.

items.en: Lord John is **brave and calm**. For example, he walks across the tree bridge last "with a balance and calm" that Malone can hardly believe.
items.ar: الصفة: شجاع وهادي. الدليل: عدّى الكوبري الأخير بهدوء غريب (Chapter 4).

items.en: Gomez is **treacherous** (خاين). He pushes the tree bridge down and traps the explorers.
items.ar: الصفة: خاين. الدليل: زق الشجرة وحبسهم (Chapter 4).

blocks.text: الشخصيات: الصفات والدليل
**1) Edward Malone — الراوي (the narrator)**

rows: After Gladys's words, he asks McArdle for a dangerous assignment (Ch 1).
He pretends to be a student of science to meet Challenger (Ch 1).
He tells the policeman "It was partly my fault" and will not press charges (Ch 2).
He leaves Fort Challenger alone at night, and "pride kept me moving" (Ch 6).
He goes back into danger with Lord John to rescue his friends (Ch 6–7).

blocks.text: Malone هو اللي بيحكي (first-person narrator)، علشان كده إحنا بنشوف كل حاجة من عينه. أهم حاجة فيه إنه **بيتغير**: في الأول كان عايز يبان بطل علشان Gladys، وفي الآخر فهم إن الشجاعة الحقيقية هي إنك **تساعد غيرك**، وقرر يروح رحلة جديدة علشان **المغامرة نفسها**.
**2) Professor George Edward Challenger — العالِم صاحب الادعاء**

rows: He throws reporters out of his house and fights Malone at their first meeting (Ch 1–2).
"I do not believe," he says. "I know." (Ch 2)
When Summerlee says "You were right", he replies, "Of course I was right." (Ch 5)
He sends a blank sheet of paper, then walks into the room at Manaos (Ch 3).
He builds a balloon to escape and brings the living pterodactyl to London (Ch 9–10).

blocks.text: Challenger شكله غريب: **أقصر** مما Malone كان متخيل بس **عريض جدًا**، ودقنه السودا نازلة على صدره. هو **عبقري بس صعب**. الكاتب بيضحكنا عليه أحيانًا (زي لما زعيم الـ ape-men طلع **شبهه**!)، بس في الآخر هو العالِم اللي **طلع كلامه صح**.
**3) Professor Summerlee — العالِم الشكّاك**

rows: At the lecture he asks for "proof that can be tested" (Ch 3), and he calls the flying creature "A large bird" (Ch 4).
When he sees the iguanodons, he says, "You were right." (Ch 5)
He and Challenger argue all through the journey (Ch 4).
In London he gives the main report as a witness, not a sceptic (Ch 10).

blocks.text: Summerlee بيمثل **العالِم الحقيقي**: مش بيصدق غير **بالدليل**. ده مش عيب، ده العلم الصح. ولما شاف بعينه **غيّر رأيه بأمانة**، ورجع لندن يدافع عن الاكتشاف.
**4) Lord John Roxton — المستكشف والصياد**

rows: He crosses the tree bridge last, with great balance and calm (Ch 4).
He once helped local workers escape from Pedro Lopez's cruel rubber-trading group (Ch 3).
He shoots the ape chief and covers the retreat with accurate shooting (Ch 7).
He keeps the camp separate from the Accala caves (Ch 8).
He secretly collects diamonds from the blue clay in the pterodactyl swamp (Ch 8–10).

blocks.text: **5) Gladys Hungerton — البنت اللي Malone عايز يتجوزها**

rows: She says she loves "a man who has done something brave" (Ch 1).
She says a truly brave man does not act just to impress someone (Ch 1).
She marries William Potts, an ordinary man, and says she perhaps wanted "a quieter life" (Ch 10).

blocks.text: Gladys **سبب البداية**، بس نهايتها **مفارقة (irony)**: Malone كان فاكر إنها هتعجب بيه كبطل، لقاها اتجوزت راجل عادي. ولاحظ إن كلامها في Chapter 1 طلع صح: الشجاعة الحقيقية **مش علشان تبهر حد**.
**6) Mr McArdle و Tarp Henry — في لندن**

rows: He gives Malone the job: "If you can get through the front door." (Ch 1)
He tells Malone not to mention newspapers and finds Challenger's latest paper (Ch 1).

blocks.text: **7) Maple White — أول واحد شاف الهضبة**

rows: His sketchbook shows the red cliffs, the rock tower and a stegosaurus-like animal (Ch 2).
He reached a remote village alone "after terrible hardship" and died there (Ch 2).

blocks.text: Maple White مات **قبل** ما القصة تبدأ، بس من غير كراسته ماكانش هيبقى في رحلة. والهضبة اتسمت على اسمه: **Maple White Land**.
**8) Zambo — المساعد المخلص**

rows: After the betrayal he climbs the rock tower and shouts, "Tell me what to do!" (Ch 4)
He stays at his camp below for weeks: "I stay here!" (Ch 8)
He meets them with a rescue party: "I knew you would come back!" (Ch 9)

blocks.text: **9) Gomez — المساعد الخاين**

rows: He works for the team while hiding that he is Pedro Lopez's brother (Ch 4).
He pushes the tree bridge down: "I have waited years for this." (Ch 4)

blocks.text: **10) The ape-men — مخلوقات بين القرد والإنسان**

rows: They drop from the trees, use clubs and vines, and capture the professors (Ch 6).
They throw Accala prisoners from a cliff in a cruel ceremony (Ch 7).

blocks.text: **11) The Accala and Maretas — شعب الهضبة**

rows: They welcome the explorers and give them shelter in their caves (Ch 7).
They refuse to help the explorers leave because they want them as protectors (Ch 8).
He secretly shows Malone the hidden passage out (Ch 9).

blocks.text: الأفكار الكبيرة (Themes)

text: A **theme** is a big idea or message that runs through the whole story. It is not one event. It is what the story makes us think about.

blocks.text: الـ **theme** يعني **الفكرة الكبيرة** اللي القصة كلها بتتكلم عنها. مش حدث واحد، لكن **رسالة** الكاتب. لما يسألك عن theme، قول الفكرة + اشرحها + هات حدث كدليل. الأفكار دي هي نفس اللي أسئلة الكتاب بتسأل عنها.

rows: الكلام الغريب محتاج دليل قوي علشان الناس تصدقه
Challenger says "I know", Summerlee asks for proof, and only the living pterodactyl convinces London.
الشجاعة مش إنك تبان بطل، لكن إنك تساعد اللي محتاجك
Malone's solo night walk vs going back with Lord John to rescue his friends.
كل واحد عنده قوة مختلفة، ومع بعض بينجحوا
Lord John's shooting, the scientists' knowledge, Zambo's loyalty and Maretas's passage.
الفرق بين اللي بيقف معاك واللي بيغدر بيك
Zambo stays below to help, while Gomez traps the explorers.
حب المعرفة بيخلي الإنسان يواجه الخطر
The scientists study the pterodactyl swamp even while they are attacked.
اللي بتكسبه من نفسك أهم من الشهرة والحب والفلوس
Malone no longer needs Gladys's approval and chooses a new adventure.

blocks.title: ملاحظة عن زمن الرواية والعنف
blocks.text: الرواية الأصلية اتكتبت سنة **1912**، وكان فيها أفكار من زمانها عن الشعوب التانية مش مقبولة النهارده. نسخة الوزارة بتتكلم عن **the Accala** باحترام. في إجابتك اتكلم عن كل الشعوب **باحترام**. ولاحظ إن Malone نفسه **ماكانش مبسوط** بالمعركة ("I found little joy in it")، وإن Summerlee قال: «We did not come here to join a war». ده يخليك تفكر: هل دخولهم الحرب كان صح؟ (ده سؤال موجود في الكتاب، وأي رأي مقبول لو بررته).

items.en: One theme of the novel is **evidence versus belief**. People only accept Challenger's claim when they see a living pterodactyl.
The novel contrasts **loyalty** and **betrayal**: Zambo stays to help, while Gomez traps the explorers.
items.ar: استخدمنا contrast علشان نوضح الـ theme.

items.en: The story shows that **true courage** means helping others. Malone goes back into danger because his friends need him.
**Teamwork** saves the expedition. No single explorer could have escaped alone.

blocks.text: جدول الأحداث المهمة (Key Events)

rows: Gladys refuses Malone, and McArdle sends him to Challenger.
Gladys رفضته وMcArdle بعته لـ Challenger
Malone writes a letter pretending to be a student.
They fight, and Malone will not press charges.
Challenger shows Maple White's sketchbook, the photograph and the wing.
The lecture: Summerlee, Lord John and Malone are chosen.
The envelope is blank, and Challenger appears at Manaos.
They cross to the plateau on a tree bridge.
Gomez destroys the bridge for revenge, and Zambo stays loyal.
They see iguanodons, and pterodactyls attack them.
Malone explores alone at night and falls into a pit.
The ape-men capture the professors, and Malone and Lord John rescue them.
The Accala and the explorers defeat the ape-men.
سؤال: هل دخولهم الحرب كان صح؟
Maretas shows them a hidden passage, and they escape.
Gladys has married William Potts, Lord John shares the diamonds, and Malone joins a new expedition.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء
items: ✗ تكتب صفة من غير دليل: «Lord John is brave.» ← ✓ «Lord John is brave. **For example**, he shoots the ape chief to save Summerlee.»
✗ تخلط بين الشخصيات: Summerlee هو **الشكّاك**، Challenger هو **صاحب الادعاء**.
✗ تقول theme كأنه حدث: «The theme is Gomez pushing the tree.» ← ✓ «The theme is **betrayal**. For example, Gomez pushes the tree.»
✗ تقول إن Gomez خان علشان الفلوس ← ✓ علشان **الانتقام لأخوه** Pedro Lopez.
✗ تقول إن الـ Accala ساعدوهم يمشوا ← ✓ الـ Accala كانوا عايزينهم **يفضلوا**، و**Maretas بس** ساعدهم في السر.
✗ تحكي القصة كلها في سؤال صغير ← جاوب على **قد السؤال** بس.

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب سؤال شخصية في 3 خطوات
items: **2) الدليل:** **For example / This is shown when** he builds a balloon to escape from the plateau.
**3) الشرح:** **This shows that** he never gives up, even when his plan seems mad.
كلمات مفيدة: This shows that… / This suggests that… / For instance… / As a result…

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
أسئلة الرواية في الكتاب بتيجي كده: سؤال **Explain** (اشرح ليه)، سؤال **Analyze** (حلّل)، سؤال **Evaluate** (قيّم وادّي رأيك)، وسؤال **JRE**. شوف المثال ده (شبه سؤال في Novel Summative Assessment):

items.en: Q: Is Summerlee's scepticism necessary for the scientific credibility of the expedition?
items.ar: السؤال: هل شك Summerlee كان ضروري علشان الناس تصدق الرحلة؟

items.en: A (J): Yes, his scepticism is necessary.
A (R): A good scientist does not accept a claim without proof, so when a sceptic changes his mind, people trust the result more.
items.ar: السبب: لما الشكّاك نفسه يصدق، الناس تثق أكتر.

items.en: A (E): At the lecture he asks for "proof that can be tested", on the plateau he says "You were right", and in London he gives the main report as a witness.
items.ar: الدليل من 3 أماكن في القصة: قبل، أثناء، وبعد الرحلة.

blocks.title: Model answer: a character question
blocks.task: Compare Zambo and Gomez. What does the contrast between them show?
text: Zambo and Gomez are both men hired at Para to help the expedition, but they are complete opposites. Gomez is treacherous. He hides the fact that Pedro Lopez was his brother and waits for his chance to take revenge on Lord John. When the explorers cross onto the plateau, he pushes the tree bridge down and leaves them trapped. Zambo, on the other hand, is loyal and dependable. Instead of leaving, he climbs the rock tower, helps the men pull food and ammunition across, and stays below for weeks.

This contrast shows the theme of loyalty and betrayal. The writer suggests that a person's true character appears in a moment of danger. Gomez chooses hatred, while Zambo chooses faithfulness, and his loyalty helps to save the expedition.
notes: بدأنا بالتشابه (both men hired at Para) وبعدين الاختلاف (opposites).
لكل شخصية: صفة + دليل من القصة (Chapter 4 و8).
استخدمنا كلمات المقارنة: but, on the other hand, while, instead of.
ختمنا بالـ theme (loyalty and betrayal) ورسالة الكاتب، وده المطلوب في «What does the contrast show?».

blocks.text: تدريب
**أولًا: اختار الإجابة الصح**

items.q:
1. Which character is the narrator of the novel?
a. Challenger  b. Lord John  c. Malone  d. Summerlee
items.a: **c. Malone** — بيحكي بـ I.

items.q:
2. Summerlee is best described as ______.
a. sceptical  b. treacherous  c. violent  d. careless
items.a: **a. sceptical** — مش بيصدق غير بالدليل.

items.q:
3. In the past, Lord John helped local workers escape from ______.
a. the ape-men  b. Pedro Lopez's rubber-trading group  c. the Accala  d. the Zoological Institute
items.a: **b** — ودي اللي خلت Gomez يكرهه.

items.q:
4. Which theme does the living pterodactyl in London show most clearly?
a. loyalty  b. evidence vs belief  c. romance  d. betrayal
items.a: **b. evidence vs belief** — الدليل النهائي.

items.q:
5. Gladys's marriage to William Potts is an example of ______.
a. irony  b. loyalty  c. revenge  d. science
items.a: **a. irony** — النتيجة عكس اللي Malone كان متوقعه.

items.q:
6. Who shows the explorers the hidden way down from the plateau?
a. Gomez  b. Maretas  c. McArdle  d. Maple White
items.a: **b. Maretas** — الزعيم الشاب اللي أنقذوه من الـ ape-men.

blocks.text: **تانيًا: مين اللي…؟ (Who…?)**

items.q: 7. Who sends Malone to interview Challenger?
items.a: **Mr McArdle**, his editor.

items.q: 8. Whose sketchbook first shows the plateau and its creatures?
items.a: **Maple White's**.

items.q: 9. Who climbs the rock tower after the betrayal and shouts "Tell me what to do!"?
items.a: **Zambo**.

items.q: 10. Who secretly collects diamonds in the pterodactyl swamp?
items.a: **Lord John Roxton**.

items.q: 11. Whose chief looks like Challenger?
items.a: **The ape-men's** chief.

blocks.text: **تالتًا: هات الصفة والدليل (Give a trait and evidence)**

items.q: 12. Give one trait of Challenger and support it with evidence.
items.a: **proud** — he says "Of course I was right." (أو bad-tempered: he fights Malone at their first meeting.)

items.q: 13. Give one trait of Malone and support it with evidence.
items.a: **fair** — he says "It was partly my fault" and will not press charges. (أو brave: he goes back to rescue his friends.)

items.q: 14. Give one trait of Gomez and support it with evidence.
items.a: **revengeful** — he destroys the bridge to take revenge for his brother.

items.q: 15. Give one trait of Summerlee and support it with evidence.
items.a: **honest** — he admits "You were right" when he sees the iguanodons.

items.q: 16. Give one trait of Maretas and support it with evidence.
items.a: **kind / brave** — he secretly shows Malone the hidden passage, although his people want the explorers to stay.

blocks.text: **رابعًا: أسئلة الـ themes وJRE**

items.q: 17. How does the novel show the theme of evidence vs belief?
items.a: Scientists refuse to believe Challenger without proof. Summerlee travels to test the claim and believes only when he sees the iguanodons. In London, the living pterodactyl finally convinces everyone.

items.q: 18. What is each main character's reason for joining the expedition?
items.a: **Malone**: to find a real challenge and a real story. **Challenger**: to prove his claim. **Summerlee**: to test the claim. **Lord John**: he knows the Amazon and loves adventure.

items.q: 19. How does the novel present loyalty and betrayal?
items.a: Through contrast: **Zambo** stays loyal, **Gomez** betrays them. The friends also stay loyal to each other when Lord John and Malone rescue the others.

items.q: 20. Are the explorers right to support the Accala against the ape-men? Justify your answer.
items.a: مثال: **Partly yes.** The ape-men were killing Accala prisoners and hunting the explorers too, and the Accala had given them shelter. **However**, Summerlee says they did not come to join a war, and Malone "found little joy" in the harsh ending. — أي رأي مقبول لو بررته.

items.q: 21. JRE: Is teamwork the main reason the expedition succeeds? Give J, R and E.
items.a: مثال: **J:** Yes. **R:** No single member could have survived or escaped alone. **E:** Zambo sent food and ammunition across, Lord John's shooting saved Summerlee, and Maretas showed them the hidden passage.

items.q: 22. JRE: Does Malone gain something more valuable than the love he first hoped for?
items.a: مثال: **J:** Yes. **R:** He gains courage, true friends and a new understanding of himself. **E:** He realises his life "no longer needed Gladys's approval" and chooses to join Lord John's new expedition.

items.q: 23. Why do you think the writer ends the novel with Gladys's marriage?
items.a: To show irony and to show that Malone has changed: he no longer needs to prove himself to anyone. Courage and adventure have become part of who he is.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: **Challenger** عبقري عصبي مغرور — **Summerlee** شكّاك أمين بقى شاهد — **Lord John** شجاع هادي عادل — **Malone** طموح عادل بيكبر وينضج.
**Zambo** مخلص ↔ **Gomez** خاين (انتقام لـ Pedro Lopez). **Gladys** = مفارقة. **Maretas** = الممر السري. **Maple White** أول شاهد.
الـ themes: evidence vs belief، true courage، teamwork، loyalty & betrayal، curiosity & discovery، personal growth.
أي إجابة: **صفة/فكرة + دليل من حدث (واذكر الفصل لو تعرفه) + شرح** (This shows that…).
